payout_quote: We will deposit $50 into the new, first-time personal checking account, and the referrer will receive $50 in their current Bell checking account after the new, first-time personal checking account has been active 60 days with either a recurring direct deposit (excludes transfers from another bank) or 10 debit card transactions (point of sale) or a recurring automatic payment. After the qualifications are met, $50 will be deposited into the accounts within 5 business days.
steps: Tell friends or family to switch to Bell Bank and let the bank know you sent them.
Your friend opens a new first-time personal checking account in person or online with a $50 minimum deposit.
The new account stays active for 60 days with a recurring direct deposit (excluding transfers from another bank), 10 point-of-sale debit card transactions, or a recurring automatic payment.
After the qualifications are met, $50 is deposited into the new account and $50 into your current Bell checking account within 5 business days.
catches: Referred friend must be a first-time Bell Bank personal checking account holder.
New account must be active 60 days with recurring direct deposit (bank-to-bank transfers excluded), 10 POS debit transactions, or a recurring automatic payment.
Referrer must hold a current Bell checking account to receive the bonus.
$50 minimum deposit to open the new checking account.
Both parties may receive a 1099-MISC for the bonus per IRS regulations.
Cannot be combined with any other Bell Bank offers.
biggest_catch: The friend must be a first-time Bell Bank personal checking customer and the new account must stay active 60 days with qualifying activity (recurring direct deposit excluding bank-to-bank transfers, 10 POS debit transactions, or recurring automatic payment); the offer cannot be combined with any other Bell Bank offer.
eligibility: Referrer must be a current Bell Bank checking customer; referred friend must be a first-time Bell personal checking account holder.
timing: Sharing takes ~5-15 minutes active; both accounts are credited within 5 business days after the 60-day qualification is met.
weasel_words: cannot be combined with any other offers
